title: Panopticon — One tool call. A record you can inspect.
description: Observe what an MCP does locally, including what was not observed.
hero_title: One tool call. A record you can inspect.
hero_summary: Panopticon runs an MCP in a decoy-filled sandbox and records what happened, plus what remains unobserved.
manual: Select the command and copy it manually.
not_pass: Not observed is not a pass.
coverage_unknown: Not observed is not a pass.

step3_result: After runtime and image prerequisites are met, one local observation record is produced.
step3_next: Otherwise keep the returned status and reason; do not infer a pass.
local_text: MCP traffic is observed inside the decoy sandbox. The first local path needs no account or remote product analytics. Unobserved ranges stay visible with their status and reason.
flow: Changes follow dry-run diff, confirm, backup, apply, re-check, and undo.
offline: --offline blocks Panopticon registry, advisory, and package lookup outbound requests; traffic attempted by the MCP under test remains observation evidence.
cta_text: Install the public release, then use doctor and watch.
prereq_intro: The public operator path is separate from repository contributor setup.
prereq_uv: Install with uv, pipx, Homebrew, or a verified native archive. Package installation contacts the selected registry or download host.
prereq_runtime: Doctor needs no container runtime. Local watch needs a running Docker or Podman and a staged digest-pinned image when offline; a missing image stops with IMAGE_NOT_PRESENT.
prereq_target: Replace SERVER_NAME with one exact name printed by doctor. A human chooses among distinct names before code runs; stop on NAME_AMBIGUOUS because watch cannot bind an installation ID.
prereq_image_link: Stage the immutable sandbox images before offline watch
install_options_intro: The Python commands pin 1.0.1; the Homebrew tap currently resolves to verified 1.0.1. The scoped npm package is not a public 1.0.1 channel.
install_try_body: A temporary uvx environment. Registry access happens before doctor starts; repeat the full uvx prefix for watch.
install_uv_body: Recommended when uv owns your command-line tools.
install_pipx_body: Use when pipx owns your isolated Python applications.
install_brew_body: Uses the brnyxx tap formula for macOS or Linuxbrew; verify the installed version.
install_native_body: Download the matching 1.0.1 archive, SHA256SUMS, and Sigstore bundle; verify before transfer and use.
copy_hero_install: Copy the primary uv install command
copy_option_uv: Copy the persistent uv install command
copy_final_install: Copy the final uv install command
copy_watch: Copy the watch command template; replace SERVER_NAME
example_caption: Illustrative, non-live evidence from one bounded file_read call.
bounded_note: COMPLETE describes collection for one named dimension in this run. UNKNOWN is a conclusion from insufficient coverage, not another stage status. No observed connection in this window is not a claim about every run.
command_map_intro: Use the smallest command that answers the question. Mutation and broader disclosure stay explicit.
boundary_observe: After human approval of one exact target, executes third-party code in the decoy sandbox; Docker or Podman
boundary_diff: Read-only comparison; unknown coverage stays visible
boundary_scan: Quick is offline; standard/deep have documented optional network paths
boundary_fix: Applying requires separate --yes; backup, re-check, and undo remain available
agent_title: Give an agent a bounded protocol
agent_intro: Agents should parse JSON, preserve nonzero exits and unknown coverage, and stop at human confirmation boundaries.
agent_prompt: Use Panopticon to inspect one MCP. Start with `pano version` and `pano doctor --offline --json`. Show the exact server names and installation identities; do not select `--all`. After I identify and authorize one exact target, run `pano watch SERVER_NAME --offline --json`; stop on `NAME_AMBIGUOUS` because watch cannot bind an installation ID. Do not use real environment values, destructive calls, remote credentials, deep semantic analysis, apply any configuration preview, or delete evidence without separate explicit authorization. Report exit code, status, reason_code, every coverage dimension, finding IDs, diagnostics, artifact paths, and all unknown or unsupported areas. Do not turn evidence into a product verdict.
agent_rule_select: A human selects one distinct server name; NAME_AMBIGUOUS stops because installation IDs are not selectable.
agent_rule_execute: Showing a command and executing third-party code are separate actions.
agent_rule_change: Every configuration change begins with a dry-run diff and preserves undo.
agent_rule_report: Reports keep status, reason_code, coverage, diagnostics, IDs, artifacts, and uncertainty.
footer_scope: Installer requests, GHCR image staging, optional feature traffic, tested-MCP traffic, and hosting follow separate documented boundaries.
footer: This first local path sends no Panopticon product telemetry and makes no product verdict.
